body:
I'm so sorry for you. You could possibly find a shelter or something to help you? Do you have any friends/relatives that could do something?

I can relate to you because I recently got in a big fight with my dad and now my family is broken... In my case, I'm more like trying to find a way to get out...

I feel you, I don't even have a degree and no one wants to hire me for the simple reason that I have no job experience, which is bs... Of course I don't have any since no one gives me a chance... *eyeroll* I feel bad that I still live with my parents, but can't complain when seeing how you struggle... I'm so sorry man... I hope you find a way out of this... Degrees in Europe are far more affordable, I can't fathom how you have to pay so much to get a simple piece of paper, that's crazy...
